items.title: Add signal heatmap and audio clip views
items.body:
### Related

* Closes #2852

### What

This PR adds first-class support for audio-oriented datasets in three layers:

* New `AudioClip` and `AudioAnnotation` archetypes for PCM tensors, sample-rate metadata, channel names, and timestamp-window text spans, generated across Rust/Python/C++ docs and SDK surfaces.
* A new `AudioView` that renders logged audio clips as time-aligned waveforms, supports per-channel visibility, mixdown display, PCM playback on native and web, looped region playback, WAV export for the full clip or selected loop region, viewer-side Hanning/Hamming and low/high/band-pass processing controls, ASR span overlays, and scrubbing the global Rerun time cursor by clicking/dragging in the waveform.
* A richer signal heatmap example that can load PCM WAV files or decode common compressed formats through `ffmpeg`, logs raw audio, waveform scalars, STFT/mel/MFCC/channel spectrogram tensors, streaming windows, ASR word spans, timestamped text tokens, and NumPy helper variants for Hanning/Hamming windows plus low/high/band-pass filtered spectrograms.

#### Issue coverage

| Original ask | Status in this PR |
| --- | --- |
| Play audio as time-series data | Adds `AudioClip` plus `AudioView` waveform display on the timeline. Native and web builds can play logged PCM tensors from the current time cursor or a looped region. The example can load PCM WAV input with `--wav` or decode common compressed audio via `--audio` and `ffmpeg`. |
| Plot changing spectrograms as audio plays / pinpoint timestamp and features / MFCC | Adds `SignalHeatmapView` for precomputed signal tensors, range-concatenates streaming chunks, and the example logs STFT, mel, MFCC, channel STFT, and streaming windows. `AudioView` and heatmap views share the global time cursor. |
| Play individual channels separately or multiple channels combined | `AudioView` supports per-channel visibility, visual mixdown, playback of the enabled channels, playback of a mono mixdown, and WAV export using the same channel/mixdown selection. |
| Correlate timestamp-window with ASR text output | Adds `AudioAnnotation` spans and renders labeled ASR windows directly in `AudioView`; the example also logs timestamped tokens in `TextLogView`. |
| Nice-to-have windows and filters | `AudioView` has viewer-side Hanning/Hamming window controls and low-pass/high-pass/band-pass filter controls that affect display and playback. The example also logs precomputed filter/window heatmap variants. |

#### Review notes

* `SignalHeatmapView` displays precomputed signal tensors instead of computing STFT/MFCC inside the viewer. The example includes NumPy-only helpers so users can produce the expected tensors without taking a dependency on a heavier audio stack.
* `tinyaudio` is used for playback because it provides a small cross-platform callback API and already has native plus WebAudio backends. Linux enables its `alsa` feature explicitly; the existing workspace dependency is reused.
* `AudioView` exports PCM16 WAV bytes directly instead of adding an encoder dependency.
* The example's `--audio` path uses a user's local `ffmpeg` executable only when requested, keeping the default example dependencies unchanged.

#### Screenshot

![Signal heatmap and audio views running in Rerun](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Reza2kn/rerun-codex-fork/codex/pr-assets/pr-assets/12842/signal_heatmap_viewer_6b8802f.png)

Captured from `.context/pr-screenshots/signal_heatmap.rrd` with the current branch viewer using the native Metal renderer.

#### Validation

* `pixi run codegen`
* `cargo fmt -p re_view_audio -p re_viewer -p re_sdk_types`
* `pixi run ruff check docs/snippets/all/archetypes/audio_clip.py docs/snippets/all/archetypes/audio_annotation.py docs/snippets/all/views/audio.py examples/python/signal_heatmap/signal_heatmap.py rerun_py/rerun_sdk/rerun/__init__.py`
* `python -m py_compile docs/snippets/all/archetypes/audio_clip.py docs/snippets/all/archetypes/audio_annotation.py docs/snippets/all/views/audio.py examples/python/signal_heatmap/signal_heatmap.py rerun_py/rerun_sdk/rerun/archetypes/audio_clip.py rerun_py/rerun_sdk/rerun/archetypes/audio_annotation.py rerun_py/rerun_sdk/rerun/blueprint/views/audio_view.py`
* `cargo check -p re_view_audio`
* `cargo test -p re_view_audio`
* `pixi run cargo check -p re_view_audio --target wasm32-unknown-unknown`
* `cargo check -p re_viewer`
* `pixi run uv run --with numpy --with rerun-sdk examples/python/signal_heatmap/signal_heatmap.py --help`
* `git diff --check`
* `pixi run uv run examples/python/signal_heatmap/signal_heatmap.py --save .context/pr-screenshots/signal_heatmap.rrd`
* `RUST_LOG=error cargo run --package rerun-cli --no-default-features --features release_no_web_viewer -- .context/pr-screenshots/signal_heatmap.rrd --headless --screenshot-to .context/pr-screenshots/signal_heatmap_viewer_quiet.png --window-size 1600x1100 --renderer=metal`
* `pixi run fast-lint`

items.title: Add selection hierarchy breadcrumbs
items.body:
### Related

* Part of https://github.com/rerun-io/rerun/issues/4491

### What
This adds "breadcrumbs" to each selection header in the selection panel, showing the ancestry of the selected thing.
That should make it obvious if the selection belong to the blueprint tree panel, or the streams panel.

items.title: Improve the Selection Panel with better title, context, and Space View key properties
items.body:
### What ~~Do not merge until after 0.11.~~ This PR reworks the Selection Panel to improve the title ("What is selected?"), the context ("Where is the selected thing to be found?"), and the key properties of Space Views (name, origin, type). This is a first step towards the WIP designs by @martenbjork related to blueprints. Changes: - Full-width, blue title bar consistent with other panel's style and with the idea that this thing is selected. - "Context" section listing the place(s) this thing is to be found. - This is much more consistant across `Item` kinds. Previously, stuff was displayed all over the place. - From StreamEntity, it's now it's possible to navigate to any related SpaceViewEntity _or_ Space Views. Previously, a button confusingly named after the space view would actually lead to the SpaceViewEntity. - For Space Views, the Name/Origin/Type are now displayed on top (for all types of space views). - This greatly increase the discoverability of the "Name" property. Previously it was hiding in plain sight in what appeared to be contextual information. **Note**: the end-game for context is bread-crumbs like these, but that's for another day as we're don't yet have an easy way to walk _up_ the hierarchy:

* Closes #4159 * Closes #4288 * Closes #4160 ### Screenshots Space View: Group: Entity in Space View: Entity in Streams: Component: ### Checklist * [x] I have read and agree to [Contributor Guide](https://github.com/rerun-io/rerun/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/rerun-io/rerun/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) * [x] I've included a screenshot or gif (if applicable) * [x] I have tested [demo.rerun.io](https://demo.rerun.io/pr/4324) (if applicable) * [x] The PR title and labels are set such as to maximize their usefulness for the next release's CHANGELOG - [PR Build Summary](https://build.rerun.io/pr/4324) - [Docs preview](https://rerun.io/preview/ed064713de2471df1cac9eeeea2173a4f4fd7c7e/docs) - [Examples preview](https://rerun.io/preview/ed064713de2471df1cac9eeeea2173a4f4fd7c7e/examples) - [Recent benchmark results](https://build.rerun.io/graphs/crates.html) - [Wasm size tracking](https://build.rerun.io/graphs/sizes.html)
